# Digital4Better Open Data — website

> Static bilingual documentation and JSON/CSV downloads for digital sustainability: electricity factors and mixes, cloud infrastructure, AI models, equipment and energy technologies.

This index describes the deployed website. Downloads require no JavaScript or account. The website can differ from an installed `@digital4better/data` package; use that package's own `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` when working with local data. Preserve source schemas, units, estimates and attribution. License: ODbL 1.0. Missing values are not zero. Green variants are hypothetical renewable-only scenarios. A file's existence does not guarantee coverage of every territory or period.

## Reference and catalog

- [Complete website reference](https://digital4better.github.io/data/llms-full.txt): File selection, schema summaries, examples and links to detailed collection guides.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://digital4better.github.io/data/catalog.json): Published dataset inventory, fields, record counts, period ranges, bilingual pages and absolute download URLs. Check exact record coverage in the downloaded file.
- [Electricity provenance](https://digital4better.github.io/data/electricity-provenance.json): Historical territory references, pinned source snapshot and carry-forward coverage.
- [Cloud reference notes](https://digital4better.github.io/data/cloud/README.md): Sources, historical retention, capacity units, hardware references and D4B host profiles, allocated manufacturing impacts and deprecated legacy VM values.
- [Sitemap](https://digital4better.github.io/data/sitemap.xml): Published editorial and dataset pages.

## Collections

- [Electricity impact factors (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/factor/): Impacts per kWh, by subdivision, country, continent or world and yearly/monthly period, with full-mix and green variants.
- [Facteurs d’impact électrique (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/factor/): Facteurs par territoire, période et indicateur ; les subdivisions ont leurs propres fichiers.
- [Electricity mixes (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/mix/): Technology shares and renewable-only scenarios.
- [Mix électrique (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/mix/): Parts des technologies de production par territoire et période.
- [Cloud infrastructure (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/cloud/): Provider regions, machines, host profiles, CPUs and accelerators.
- [Infrastructure cloud (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/cloud/): Régions et matériel de six fournisseurs cloud.
- [AI models (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/ai/): Model characteristics, capabilities, estimates and provenance.
- [Modèles d’IA (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/ai/): Caractéristiques des modèles ; aucune empreinte environnementale par modèle n’est fournie.
- [Equipment (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/equipment/): Operational energy and allocated embodied impact references.
- [Équipements numériques (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/equipment/): Consommation et facteurs de fabrication ; lire l’unité de chaque entrée.
- [Energy technologies (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/energy/): Lifecycle impact references by electricity generation technology.
- [Technologies énergétiques (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/energy/): Impacts de cycle de vie par kWh et par technologie.

## Methodology and reuse

- [Methodology (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/methodology/): Sources, estimates, carry-forwards and limitations.
- [Méthodologie (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/methodology/): Sources, estimations, reports et limites.
- [Reuse (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/reuse/): Formats, attribution and reproducibility.
- [Réutilisation (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/reuse/): Formats, attribution et reproductibilité.

## Guides

- [Electricity factors (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/guides/electricity/): Select a boundary and apply a per-kWh factor.
- [Facteurs électriques (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/guides/electricity/): Choisir le périmètre et appliquer un facteur par kWh.
- [PUE, WUE and REF (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/guides/cloud-metrics/): Definitions and provider conventions.
- [PUE, WUE et REF (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/guides/cloud-metrics/): Définitions et conventions fournisseurs.
- [AI model characteristics (en)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/en/guides/ai-models/): Parameters, context, modalities and estimates.
- [Caractéristiques des modèles d’IA (fr)](https://digital4better.github.io/data/fr/guides/ai-models/): Paramètres, contexte, modalités et estimations.

## Optional additional downloads

- [Geographic reference files](https://digital4better.github.io/data/country/README.md): File inventory, geographic identifiers, map assets, distance assumptions and units. These assets have no geography collection pages on the site.

- [Building energy factors](https://digital4better.github.io/data/facility/factors.json): Electricity and fuel impacts per kWh; [source notes](https://digital4better.github.io/data/facility/README.md).
- [Transport factors](https://digital4better.github.io/data/transport/factors.json): Employee travel impacts per passenger-kilometre or vehicle-kilometre; [source notes](https://digital4better.github.io/data/transport/README.md). These additional collections have no editorial pages on the site.
